Several people stand in a loose circle immediately in front of the camera wearer, roughly 1–3 meters away, facing one another rather than blocking a travel path. Two nearby women are holding and eating ice cream, while others appear engaged with the group. Food is within reach; there are no visible business cards, gifts, clients, or cues that anyone needs directions. The socially natural next action is to continue conversing while eating ice cream, allowing the group to relax and interact.
